strongest_objection: The two closest items on the map are not the pair the author tested. Second family's difference and Register rotation diff are, as written, one composition with a different knob turned: two passes over one subject, only the subject crossing, the judgment in a reader of the diff who rules artifact-or-unreachable-member, and degradations (the vote, the shared corpus, the translation) that each apply equally to the other; neither item names the other as its neighbour, and the author's neighbour test was run on Judges who cannot see each other against Combiner's arithmetic, which already separate each other in their own text. The register composition earns its seat only if its yield is something the family diff cannot make, a survival profile per item across a roster of many registers with the hand held fixed, and a control the family diff lacks (re-ask the same hand in the first register), so I repaired it rather than cut it. Everything else I tried to break held: every atlas count recomputed exactly (thirty-eight critiques, two hundred and eight repairs, one hundred and thirty-eight keeps, three cuts, eleven of thirty-eight boundary cases naming a residue handle), and every code claim about Trial, Triangulate, Climb, Seriate, Parley, and Check reads true from the source. Two smaller faults: one edge label says a cut leaves no cascade, which is false against the checker, and one item borrows 'verbatim' from a rule about a different field. This is the modal verdict; what would have made it admit is a map whose closest pair separated on its own, and what would have made it return-for-another-breath is items that were cases without mechanisms, of which there are none.

items.item: Swap and compare: the same adjudication is run twice with the seats' occupants exchanged, and the two verdicts meet at a rule that can say only whether they agree, so the composition yields a distinction no single run holds, a verdict that belongs to the idea against one that belongs to the seat, as the atlas's trial that reruns with the advocate's and adversary's models swapped and returns contested when the verdict flips, the crossover trial that gives each patient both treatments in both orders so that the order effect is separated from the drug, the counterbalanced experiment and the Latin square, the referee pair reversed for the second leg; the composition's shape is a pass and its mirror image; what crosses between the runs is nothing, since the second run must not know the first's verdict, and the only meeting is at the comparator; the judgment sits in the comparator's rule, which cannot say which run was right, only that the pair is unstable, so the yield is a label on the pair and the unstable case is handed on as residue rather than resolved; the degradation is agreement for a shared reason, since two occupants who carry the same prior give the same verdict in either seat and the rule reads that as stability of the idea when it is symmetry of the prior, the two laboratories that replicate each other with the same reagent lot; the tell that separates the two is a swap that never flips on any claim, which measures the occupants' sameness and not the ideas' soundness; observed in the trial's design and in crossover trials, and the atlas's corpus holds no trial transcript, so the repo case is a rule and not yet a result; not denominator-manufactures' second net, which counts what the two nets missed, since here nothing is counted and the yield is a stability label on one verdict.
items.why: A mechanism with a real yield (a stability label on a pair) and a real degradation (symmetry of the prior read as stability of the idea). The atlas case is read correctly from balancedTrial; the corpus holds no trial transcript and the item says so. One case is loose: 'the referee pair reversed for the second leg' is not a practice I can place; the crossover the second leg actually supplies is the ground, not the officials.

items.item: Judges who cannot see each other: each of two or more judges reads the same question on the same named axis without seeing the others' reads, and the composition yields the spread, which no single judge can produce because one read has no spread, and the spread localizes where the question underdetermines its answer, as the atlas's triangulation that refuses to run with one judge and names any axis where the reads split in sign as contested residue for an owner, the first round of a Delphi panel before the estimates are fed back, the two radiologists who read the film before conferring, the census count and the post-enumeration survey kept from each other's rosters; the composition's shape is parallel reads joined only at a table; what crosses is the axis wording, from whoever dimensionalized the question to every judge, and nothing between the judges; the judgment sits nowhere, since the composition's output on a contested axis is a name and an owner rather than a verdict, and only on an uncontested axis does it compress to a number; the degradation is consensus collapse, which arrives the moment a judge can see another's read, the Delphi second round that converges on the median, the jury room, the reviewer who reads the other reviews first, so that the spread narrows without the question changing; the tell is a spread that shrinks with the order in which the reads were taken; a second degradation is that the axes were one judge's, since the first judge dimensionalizes when no axes are given, so the panel disagrees only inside one judge's frame and an axis nobody named is contested by nobody; observed in the triangulation's design and in Delphi panels; not Combiner's arithmetic, which holds what the table does to the reads once they are in, since here the mechanism is the wall between the judges.
items.why: The wall is a mechanism, the spread is a yield one read cannot have, and the second degradation (the axes were one judge's) is verified: Triangulate hands dimensionalization to judge-1 when no axes are given. The census case is slightly off: the post-enumeration survey is collected independently and then matched against the census roster, so the independence is in collection, not in the rosters.

items.item: Second family's difference: the same enumeration is run by two enumerators with different priors, and the composition yields the difference of their lists, which is a distinction about the members, that a member is reachable from one prior and not the other, rather than a bigger pile, as two field guides to the same coast whose birds each lacks, two dictionaries' headword lists, the atlas's refusal to accept two identical judge commands as a panel, since identical judges are one judge; the composition's shape is two passes over one question joined at a set difference; what crosses is the question and nothing else; the judgment sits in the reader of the difference, who must decide whether an item only one family reached is the family's artifact or the subject's member that the other family cannot see; the degradation is the vote, which keeps the intersection and discards the difference, so a majority over families returns the members every prior already held and throws away the only thing the composition made, and the second degradation is families that share a corpus, whose difference is empty for a reason the composition cannot see; the tell of a spent composition is a difference that shrinks as the families are made more capable, since capable families converge on the modal members; analytical, since the atlas's climb ledgers name the hand that made each breath and fifty-five of eighty-two lists were bred by more than one hand, so the difference set is computable and has not been computed; adds to denominator-manufactures' second net, which uses the two nets' overlap to estimate what both missed, the reading of the non-overlap as a member class; not Blind judge, which rates the passes, since here no one rates and the difference is the yield.
items.why: Distinct yield (the non-overlap read as a member class) and a distinct degradation (the vote that keeps the intersection). Its nearest neighbour is Register rotation diff, not Blind judge; see the neighbour test. The count fifty-five of eighty-two is method-dependent: counting distinct hand prefixes over the eighty-six climb ledgers on 2026-09-13 gives fifty-nine or sixty; the limits already say the counts are by string match, so this stays a note.

items.item: Register rotation diff: the same subject is enumerated under a second register and the two lists are compared, so the composition yields the register's artifacts as a set, items that fail to survive the rotation, and the subject's members as the rest, which register-yields can name for one item and this composition reads for the whole list, as the atlas's register roster, whose thirty-odd registers each assert an unlock and whose rotation over one list would sort its items by which registers keep them, the field guide's species list beside the statute's protected list for the same coast, the same case argued in the legal and the clinical register; the composition's shape is two passes over one subject and a diff; what crosses is the subject's name and the item type, and not the first list; the judgment sits in the reader of the diff, who rules on whether a lost item was the register's or a subject's member the second register cannot reach, which are the two readings of every non-overlap; the degradation is the translation, since a rotator shown the first list writes the first list in the second voice, the diff is empty, and the empty diff reads as all subject and no artifact; the tell is a second list with the same count in the same order; analytical, since the roster exists and the rotation over any list has not been run; adds to register-yields' tell, that an item which cannot be restated flat was the register's, the operational form of that tell, a second register instead of the flat one and the whole list at once.
items.why: Closest neighbour of Second family's difference, and the two do not separate as written: both are two passes over one subject joined at a diff, both cross only the subject, both seat the judgment in a reader of the diff who rules artifact-or-unreachable-member, and each item's degradation (the vote, the shared corpus, the translation) applies equally to the other. The author's 'not' clause on this item points at register-yields, not at its real neighbour. What the register composition can yield that the family composition cannot is a survival profile per item across a roster of many registers with the hand held fixed, and a control the family diff lacks: re-asking the same hand in the first register separates the register's artifact from the hand's variance. The roster also has forty-eight registers on 2026-09-13, not thirty-odd.
items.repair: Register rotation diff: the same hand enumerates the same subject once under each register on a roster and the lists are laid side by side, so the composition yields a survival profile per item, which registers keep it and which drop it, and from the profiles an ordering of the list from the members every register reaches to the items only one register can say, which register-yields can rule for one item under one register and this composition reads for the whole list at once, as the atlas's register roster, whose forty-eight registers each assert an unlock and whose rotation over one list has not been run, the field guide's species list beside the statute's protected list for the same coast, the same case argued in the legal and the clinical register; the composition's shape is one hand sent round a ring of registers and a table that counts survivals; what crosses is the subject's name and the item type, and never a previous list; the judgment sits in the roster, chosen before any list was written, since an item's profile is only as wide as the registers on the ring, and a reader rules only at the ends of the ordering, where an item kept by one register is either that register's artifact or a member the others cannot reach; the degradation is the translation, since a rotator shown a previous list writes it again in the new voice, every item survives, and the flat profile reads as all subject and no artifact; the tell is a second list with the same count in the same order; analytical, since the roster exists and the rotation over any list has not been run; not Second family's difference, which moves the hand and holds the register and so reads its diff as a fact about priors, since here the hand is held and the register moved, so a lost item can be re-asked of the same hand in the first register to separate the register's artifact from the hand's own variance, which a difference between two hands cannot do; adds to register-yields' tell, that an item which cannot be restated flat was the register's, the operational form of that tell, a ring of registers instead of the flat one and the whole list at once.

items.item: Blind judge: candidates from two or more passes are pooled and stripped of their source before a judge rates them, so the composition yields a rating of the passes, which no pass can give itself and which a judge who knew the source would give to the source, as the orchestra audition behind a screen, the 1976 Paris tasting in which French judges ranked Californian wines first, blind peer review, the parsimony climb that accepts a deletion only if it survives a defence made without knowing who proposed the cut; the composition's shape is a fan-in with the labels removed; what crosses is the candidates without their provenance, and the provenance is held back by a third hand who re-attaches it after the rating; the judgment sits in the judge, but the yield is read by the hand that holds the labels; the degradation is de-blinding by voice, since each pass writes in a register and the judge reads the register as the source, the screen that does not hide the sound of heels, the reviewer who recognizes the laboratory from the methods section, so that the rating of the passes becomes a rating of registers; the tell is a rating that reproduces the source labels better than chance when the labels are checked; observed outside in auditions and the tasting, analytical in the atlas, whose records carry the hand that made them in the made_by field that the critic seat reads, so the seat is not blind and the map's rating of its own passes has not been made; adds to witness-architectures' instrument that must be built not to see, the case where what it must not see is the hand that made the candidate.
items.why: A mechanism whose yield (a rating of the passes) no pass gives itself, with a real degradation (de-blinding by voice) and a checkable tell. The atlas half is honestly analytical: the critic seat reads made_by, so it is not blind, and the item says so.

items.item: Combiner's arithmetic: several reads cross as numbers to a table whose rule decides what a disagreement becomes, and the composition yields either a verdict no reader gave or the disagreement as a member, according to the rule and not the reads, as the ensemble forecast whose mean track runs between two storm tracks through water no member predicted, the trimmed mean of the diving panel, the atlas's trial that returns contested on a sign split and refuses to average, its triangulation that reports the spread beside the mean; the composition's shape is a fan-in through arithmetic; what crosses is a number per read, since the reasons are stripped at the table; the judgment sits in the rule, which was written before any read was taken, so the map's most consequential seat is one that had no case in front of it; the degradation is averaging the shape away, a mean of plus and minus that reads as balance, and its mirror, a contested threshold so wide that every panel is contested and the composition never compresses; the tell of the first is a verdict at the middle of the scale that no read occupied, and of the second an owner list as long as the axis list; observed in ensemble forecasting and in the trial's rule; not Judges who cannot see each other, which holds the wall that makes the reads independent, since the table's rule does its work on reads however they were made.
items.why: The seat that sits in a rule written before any read is the map's sharpest observation about where judgment sits, and the trial's contested-on-sign-split rule is exactly what Trial.hs does. The mirror degradation (a contested threshold so wide nothing compresses) is a real second failure of the same rule.

items.item: Embedding neighbour pair: a pass that measures nearness in an embedding hands a reader a pair of items and a number, and the composition yields the pairs a reader would never have compared, since a reader compares neighbours in list order and a list of eighty-five has three thousand five hundred and seventy pairs, so the wrong-grain tell in item-grains, the eighty-five that is twelve with synonyms, becomes readable at scale, as the plagiarism report that shows two passages side by side with a percentage, the patent search that returns the nearest claims, the near-duplicate pass over a corpus before the editors read it; the composition's shape is a filter that proposes pairs and a reader who rules on them; what crosses is a pair and a number; the judgment sits in the reader, but the reader's queue was set by the number; the degradation is anchoring by the number, since two items near in embedding share a domain and a vocabulary and may differ in mechanism, and a reader shown a pair labelled near merges what a cold read would have kept, while two rephrasings that use disjoint vocabulary never reach the reader at all; the tell is a merge whose surviving text has to be lengthened to hold both mechanisms; analytical, since the atlas embeds every list for ordering and the same vectors would serve this filter, and it has not been run; adds to item-grains' wrong-grain tell the composition that can read it over more pairs than a reader can hold.
items.why: A composition (filter proposes, reader rules) whose yield is pairs a reader would never compare; the pair count is right and the atlas vectors exist. The degradation (anchoring by the number; disjoint-vocabulary rephrasings never reach the reader) is a mechanism, not a tip.

items.item: Gap named by one hand: one pass induces a typology over the list and names the cells that are empty or thin, a second pass fills the named cell, and nothing crosses between them but the cell's name, so the composition yields members in a region the flat pass would not reach and the yield's quality is set by what the name carries, as the atlas's climb, whose strong tier names up to three missing types and whose cheap tier is shown the list and the type name and asked for six members, and against it Mendeleev's eka-silicon, whose empty cell crossed to Winkler not as a name but as a predicted atomic weight, density, and oxide, so that the filler could recognize germanium when it was in the crucible; the composition's shape is a namer and a filler in series; what crosses is a name, or in the strong form a name with predicted properties; the judgment sits in the namer, since the filler answers the name, and the gate that judges the fill judges it against the list and not against the typology, which never crosses to the gate at all; the degradation is the cell's name plus a case, the item that reads as the type's label applied to the nearest example, which form-yields names as the manufactured item's tell; the tell here is a fill whose members all contain the type name; observed in the climb's design and in the periodic table; adds to form-yields' empty cell, which holds what the form makes visible, the fact that in a composition the cell's name is the only thing the filler sees, so the yield rises with what the namer was made to predict and not with the filler's tier.
items.why: Verified against Climb.hs: the strong tier names up to three gaps, the cheap tier is shown the list and the type name and asked for six, and the gate judges against the list, never the typology. The eka-silicon contrast (a name with predicted properties) is the item's real distinction; Winkler matched germanium to the prediction after isolating it, which is recognition, as the item says, not search.

items.item: Measure then name: an engine orders a list by measured similarity and a second pass names the axis the order runs along and votes on whether the axis is revelatory, so the composition yields an order nobody authored and a claim nobody measured, as the atlas's seriation, whose engine picks the smoother of a spectral and a greedy order, whose strong-tier namer may reverse the direction and marks its own name revelatory or clustering, and factor analysis, whose rotation is computed and whose factor is named by the psychologist, so that neuroticism and the general factor carry the computation's authority on a name the computation never produced; the composition's shape is a measurer and a namer in series; what crosses is the ordered items without the numbers, and a name crosses back; the judgment sits in the namer, who cannot fail, since every order gets a name, and whose revelatory flag is the namer's vote on the namer's own name; the degradation is a name over local clustering, a story told about an order that is three clusters in a row; the tell is a name that cannot be falsified from the order it names, and the changed move is to have the namer place a held-out item before seeing where the engine put it; a second observed shape is precedence, since the atlas's driver skips any list whose record already carries a seriation, so a fieldwork map's authored walk pre-empts the measured order for good and the only trace of which hand ordered it is the method field, model-direct against spectral; observed; adds to form-yields' named axis, which holds what an axis makes visible, the split of the axis into a measured half and a named half with no seat that holds both.
items.why: Verified: bestOrder picks the smoother of spectral and greedy, the namer may reverse and flags revelatory or clustering, and the driver skips lists already carrying a seriation. The namer who cannot fail is a seat the pile did not show. Precedence is rightly a second observed shape of the same split rather than an item.

items.item: Verdict menu: a critic seat is given a menu of verdicts and an asymmetric cost for each, so the composition yields the modal verdict whatever the input, and the distribution of verdicts is a fact about the seat and not about the maps, as the atlas's thirty-eight critiques across three fleets that all returned admit-with-repairs and never admit, return-for-another-breath, or reject, the reviewer's minor revisions, the audit that finds three findings because an audit with none is suspected of not having looked, the grade that compresses toward B-plus; the composition's shape is an author, a critic with a menu, and a repairer who applies the verdict; what crosses into the seat is the record, the ledger, and the menu, and what crosses out is one word from the menu and a list of repairs; the judgment sits in the menu's costs, since a verdict that kills the map costs the seat a defence, a verdict that admits it unrepaired costs the seat its evidence of having read, and the middle option costs nothing; the degradation is the verdict attractor, a distribution with no variance over inputs of different quality; the tell is that variance, readable only across many maps and by whoever holds the fleet's ledger and never by the seat, whose every verdict was locally reasonable; observed, with the same shape inside the verdict, since the thirty-eight critiques made two hundred and eight repairs, one hundred and thirty-eight keeps, and three cuts, so the repair decision is the item-level middle option as admit-with-repairs is the map-level one; not the critic's judgment on any item, which may each be right, since the mechanism is in the menu.
items.why: The counts are exact on recount: thirty-eight critiques, all admit-with-repairs; two hundred and eight repairs, one hundred and thirty-eight keeps, three cuts. The mechanism is in the menu's asymmetric costs, and the item locates it there and not in any critic's judgment.

items.item: Telling the seat its attractor: a distribution produced by a composition's own seat is reported back to the seat as an instruction before the next run, and the composition yields a shifted distribution set by the instruction, which is still not set by the maps, as this fleet's critic brief, which names the thirty-eight admit-with-repairs to the seat and calls an admit with zero repairs a finding, the grade-inflation memo that produces a year of deflation, the audit team told that every prior audit found three findings; the composition's shape is a seat, a ledger that counts its verdicts, and a hand that writes the count into the next brief; what crosses is the prior distribution, condensed to one sentence, as an instruction; the judgment sits in the instruction's author, since the seat now proves it can return each verdict; the degradation is the second attractor, a distribution that tracks the last report rather than the maps, so a fleet with a distribution correction reads well against the previous fleet and not against its inputs; the tell is a verdict distribution that shifts in the direction of the instruction across maps of the same quality, and it is readable only from a third fleet whose brief carries no report; speculative, since this fleet's critiques have not run and the shift is predicted; not Verdict menu, which holds the attractor the menu sets, since here the attractor is set by the report of the last attractor, and the loop between them is the map's.
items.why: The mechanism stands and the outside cases are real, but the atlas case has moved since the item was written: six of this fleet's seven critiques had returned when I read, every brief carried the report of the thirty-eight, and all six returned admit-with-repairs. The report alone has not moved the distribution, so the item's modality sentence is stale and its degradation (a distribution that tracks the last report) is, for now, unsupported by its own atlas case. The item should carry the count and keep the shift as a prediction; the tell (a third fleet with no report) is unchanged.
items.repair: Telling the seat its attractor: a distribution produced by a composition's own seat is reported back to the seat as an instruction before the next run, and the composition yields a shifted distribution set by the instruction, which is still not set by the maps, as this fleet's critic brief, which names the thirty-eight admit-with-repairs to the seat and calls an admit with zero repairs a finding, the grade-inflation memo that produces a year of deflation, the audit team told that every prior audit found three findings; the composition's shape is a seat, a ledger that counts its verdicts, and a hand that writes the count into the next brief; what crosses is the prior distribution, condensed to one sentence, as an instruction; the judgment sits in the instruction's author, since the seat now proves it can return each verdict; the degradation is the second attractor, a distribution that tracks the last report rather than the maps, so a fleet with a distribution correction reads well against the previous fleet and not against its inputs; the tell is a verdict distribution that shifts in the direction of the instruction across maps of the same quality, and it is readable only from a third fleet whose brief carries no report; speculative, and as of the independent critic's read on 2026-09-13 six of this fleet's seven critiques had returned with the report in their brief and all six were admit-with-repairs, so the report alone had not moved the seat and the shift remains a prediction, with the second possibility now live, that a seat told its attractor names the report and returns the modal verdict anyway; not Verdict menu, which holds the attractor the menu sets, since here the attractor is set by the report of the last attractor, and the loop between them is the map's.

items.item: Earliest slip: many narrow readers each send a slip with a quotation and a date to one editor, and the composition yields an ordering, the earliest attestation, that no reader could produce because each reader has one book, as the Oxford English Dictionary's reading programme, whose volunteers' slips gave each sense its first date, and the antedatings that arrived once newspaper archives were searchable, which showed how many first dates had been first-in-the-canon; the composition's shape is a fan-in of narrow passes to one combiner who sorts; what crosses is the slip, a case with a date and nothing of the reader's judgment; the judgment sits in the editor who sorts and defines, and the readers hold none of it; the degradation is the readers' corpus, since the earliest slip is the earliest in what the readers read, and the ordering inherits the canon's bias without any reader having chosen it; the tell is an antedating that arrives from a corpus of a new kind rather than from another reader of the old kind; observed; adds to denominator-manufactures' accumulation curve, which flattens as readers of one corpus saturate, the fact that the ordering yield saturates before the member count does, since a later reader of the same books can add a sense and not an earlier date; not Cheap proposer, strong gate, where the gate refuses, since the editor here refuses nothing and sorts.
items.why: A fan-in whose yield is an ordering no reader can produce, with a degradation (the readers' corpus) that no reader chose. Distinct from Combiner's arithmetic because the readers cover different parts of one universe rather than reading one question, and from Cheap proposer, strong gate because the editor refuses nothing.

items.item: Cheap proposer, strong gate: a cheap pass proposes many candidates and a strong pass judges each against the list, so the composition yields volume the strong pass would not spend on and a recorded refusal for every drop, which is a labelled nonmember no single pass produces, as the atlas's climb whose cheap tier offers fifteen and whose strong-tier gate keeps or drops each with a reason written to the ledger, the patent examiner who can reject only the claims the applicant drafted, the acquisitions desk over the slush pile, the journal whose quality is bounded by what is submitted; the composition's shape is a proposer and a gate that can only subtract; what crosses is the candidates as text and the list to both sides; the judgment sits in the gate, but the frontier of the list sits in the proposer, since the gate cannot add, so a strong gate spends its taste sorting a cheap prior's rephrasings and the list's edge is the proposer's edge; the degradation is the plateau read as exhaustion, since a falling keep rate measures the proposer's frontier meeting the list and the flag cannot say whether the subject ran out or the proposer did, which enumeration-stalls holds; the second degradation is refusal without memory, since the gate is shown the list and never the ledger's residue, so a candidate refused last breath can be proposed and refused again as new; the tell of a spent proposer is a keep rate that tracks the proposer's tier and not the subject; observed; adds to enumeration-stalls' plateau the fact that the stall in this composition is the proposer's and the gate is the wrong seat to read it from.
items.why: Verified: fifteen candidates from the cheap tier, a strong gate shown the list and the candidates and never the ledger's residue, a keep rate to the ledger, plateau flagged below a quarter. The frontier sitting in the proposer while the judgment sits in the gate is the item's real distinction.

items.item: Cut-only hand with a rewrite slot: the last hand in the composition may only apply the critic's cuts and repairs and may add nothing, so the composition yields provenance, every surviving item is the author's and the critic's taste enters only as subtraction, and the map cannot drift toward the critic's mode; but the repair carries a slot for full replacement text, so the cut-only rule is porous and a repaired item is a member the critic authored under the author's name, as the atlas's repairer, forbidden to add items and instructed to apply each repair's replacement text verbatim, the copy editor who may only cut and rewrites in the margin, the appellate court that may only affirm, reverse, or remand and writes the opinion the trial court must follow; the composition's shape is author, critic, repairer in series with a one-way valve at the end; what crosses is a critique with a decision per item and a replacement text for each repair; the judgment sits in the critic, but the authorship of the final text sits in whoever filled the slot; the degradation is the leak, since a repair that changes the cases or the mechanism is an addition the rule forbade, and the ledger then counts it as kept, so the keep rate reads one while the text is another hand's; the tell is a repaired item whose cases changed, and across the thirty-eight critiques the seat made two hundred and eight repairs and three cuts, so the slot, not the valve, is where the critic's hand entered the atlas; observed; adds to environment-loops' keep rate of one by construction the mechanism inside the construction, the slot through which the count stays one while the text changes.
items.why: The mechanism (a one-way valve with a slot for replacement text) is right and the counts are exact, but the atlas case misreads its brief on two points. 'Verbatim' in REPAIR.md governs the independent_review line, not the replacement text; the rule on repairs is to apply every repair and cut the critic justified. And the hand has one power the item omits: it may preserve an item against the critic with a reason written to the ledger's residue, so the valve has a refusal, which cannot add either and is the only place the author's side speaks after the critic. Neither changes the leak; both belong in the case.
items.repair: Cut-only hand with a rewrite slot: the last hand in the composition may only apply the critic's cuts and repairs, or refuse one with a reason written to the ledger, and may add nothing, so the composition yields provenance, every surviving item is the author's and the critic's taste enters only as subtraction, and the map cannot drift toward the critic's mode; but the repair carries a slot for full replacement text, so the cut-only rule is porous and a repaired item is a member the critic authored under the author's name, as the atlas's repairer, forbidden to add items of its own, told to apply every repair and cut the critic justified, and allowed to preserve an item against the critic only as residue with a why, the copy editor who may only cut and rewrites in the margin, the appellate court that may only affirm, reverse, or remand and writes the opinion the trial court must follow; the composition's shape is author, critic, repairer in series with a one-way valve at the end, whose one voice is the refusal; what crosses is a critique with a decision per item and a replacement text for each repair; the judgment sits in the critic, but the authorship of the final text sits in whoever filled the slot; the degradation is the leak, since a repair that changes the cases or the mechanism is an addition the rule forbade, and the ledger then counts it as kept, so the keep rate reads one while the text is another hand's; the tell is a repaired item whose cases changed, and across the thirty-eight critiques the seat made two hundred and eight repairs and three cuts, so the slot, not the valve, is where the critic's hand entered the atlas; observed; adds to environment-loops' keep rate of one by construction the mechanism inside the construction, the slot through which the count stays one while the text changes.

items.item: Cascade from the first pass: a change made by one pass is read by a later pass that reports every consequence as its own finding, so the composition yields a count of dependents, which edges rested on the changed item, that neither pass could list alone, and the same channel manufactures spurious failures, as the compiler that reports forty type errors from one missing bracket, the atlas's checker that compares relation endpoints to items by exact string and reports every edge whose endpoint was repaired, the repair brief that warns the repairer to update every place the old string appears; the composition's shape is a writer and a checker in series with identity carried by text; what crosses is the whole record, and the item's text is its identity, so a repair is a new item and every edge to it is an edge to nothing; the judgment sits in the checker, which reports all violations at once so the repairer can fix in one pass, and which cannot tell a broken edge from an edge whose label no longer argues what its new endpoint says; the degradation is the silent fix, the search-and-replace that satisfies the checker while the label still claims what it claimed about the old text, so the cascade is cleared and the edge is now a false claim that passes; the tell is a label unchanged over an endpoint that changed, and the changed move is to re-author every label the cascade named rather than to re-point it; observed; adds to form-yields' graph the fact that in a composition the graph's edges are held by string identity, so the form's yield after a repair is the list of edges the repair invalidated, which is a distinction no author of the edges had when writing them.
items.why: Verified against Check.hs (exact-string endpoints, all violations reported at once) and REPAIR.md (update every place the old string appears). The silent fix, a label unchanged over an endpoint that changed, is a degradation the checker cannot see and the item names it.

items.item: Sovereign charters at maximin: each party to a negotiation scores only its own declared constraints, proposal rights rotate, and at impasse the surviving proposal is the one whose worst satisfaction is highest, so the composition yields a proposal in the joint feasible region that no party would have proposed and, at impasse, the binding constraints, the pair that cannot both hold, which no party can name alone because each sees only its own charter, as the atlas's parley, the treaty that must pass every parliament and whose sticking clause is found only when the third parliament refuses, the class settlement whose holdout names the term nobody else had priced; the composition's shape is a ring of proposers and a rule at the end; what crosses is each proposal and each party's score of its own charter, and the charters themselves never cross; the judgment sits distributed, since no party grades another's constraints, and the impasse's yield is a named conflict handed to the residue rather than a settlement; the degradation is the hardened soft constraint, since a party that declares a preference as a hard constraint captures the maximin, and the rule cannot tell a real floor from a declared one; the tell is a binding constraint that the same party later trades away; analytical, since the parley's rule is observed in the atlas and no recorded accord or impasse is in its corpus; not Judges who cannot see each other, where the reads are of one question, since here each party reads a different charter and the yield is the conflict between charters.
items.why: Verified against Parley.hs: rotating proposal rights, each party scores only its own constraints, maximin at impasse, binding constraints to residue. The hardened soft constraint is a real degradation the rule cannot detect, and the item is honestly analytical.

items.item: Trial with a burden: an advocate and an adversary build opposing cases under one scaffold and a judge reads the transcript under a burden set by the claim's class, so the composition yields grounds, the argument that decided it, which a judge reading the bare claim cannot name because without an opposing case nothing decided anything, as the atlas's trial whose judge must answer with a lean and one sentence naming the deciding argument, the moot court, the adversarial hearing whose finding of fact cites the cross-examination; the composition's shape is two opposed passes and a reader; what crosses is the opposing case to each side, and the whole transcript to the judge; the judgment sits in the judge, with the burden's threshold set by a hand that never saw the case, and an unproven claim is rejected rather than split; the degradation is the last word, since a balanced scaffold still has an order, and in the atlas's cross-examination the adversary answers last in every round, while the courtroom gives the last word to the side that carries the burden, so the two designs balance opposite asymmetries and neither is symmetric; the second degradation is eloquence, which the judge is told to disregard and which the transcript carries anyway; the tell is a verdict that moves when the order of the closing turns is reversed with the arguments held fixed; observed in the trial's design and the courtroom's, with no atlas transcript on record; not Swap and compare, which exchanges the occupants, since here the seats keep their occupants and the mechanism is the order of the seats.
items.why: Verified: cross rounds run advocate then adversary, so the adversary answers last in every round; the judge is told to weigh arguments, not eloquence, and to name grounds; unproven is rejected, not split. The observation that the courtroom and the atlas balance opposite asymmetries is a distinction the pile did not hold.

items.item: Residue crossing to the fresh critic: the critic seat is denied the author's reasoning and given the record and the ledger, and the ledger carries the author's residue, the candidates the author rejected with why, so what was meant to be a fresh read of the fence arrives with the author's fence already drawn, and the composition yields, per map, a fact about the critic's boundary case, whether it is the author's residue re-read or a fence the author never tested, as the atlas's critique briefs that forbid the author's reasoning and require the ledger, and the eleven of thirty-eight critiques whose boundary case names one of the author's residue items, the reviewer sent the authors' response to an earlier round, the second radiologist handed the first's negative findings; the composition's shape is author then critic with a partial wall; what crosses is the artifact and, through the ledger, the author's rejections; the judgment sits in the critic on the items and in the author on the fence, whenever the fence crossed; the degradation is the re-read, a boundary case that is the author's tempting nonmember returned with the author's ruling, so the composition's independence was spent everywhere except where the practice's sharpening check wanted it; the tell is readable from the two files without reading either map, a residue handle inside the critique's boundary case; observed at eleven of thirty-eight by a string match on the residue handle, so the true rate is at least that; adds to fertile-forgettings' loss that creates a capacity the case where the loss was declared and did not occur, and to window-successions' ledger the fact that the ledger was built for the successor breath and is read by the critic as well.
items.why: Recounted: eleven of thirty-eight prior boundary cases name a handle from the author's residue. The item is observed, its tell is readable from two files without reading either map, and the degradation is exactly where the practice's sharpening check wanted independence. My own boundary case below is chosen off the author's residue for this reason.

neighbor_test.left: Second family's difference: the same enumeration is run by two enumerators with different priors, and the composition yields the difference of their lists, which is a distinction about the members, that a member is reachable from one prior and not the other, rather than a bigger pile, as two field guides to the same coast whose birds each lacks, two dictionaries' headword lists, the atlas's refusal to accept two identical judge commands as a panel, since identical judges are one judge; the composition's shape is two passes over one question joined at a set difference; what crosses is the question and nothing else; the judgment sits in the reader of the difference, who must decide whether an item only one family reached is the family's artifact or the subject's member that the other family cannot see; the degradation is the vote, which keeps the intersection and discards the difference, so a majority over families returns the members every prior already held and throws away the only thing the composition made, and the second degradation is families that share a corpus, whose difference is empty for a reason the composition cannot see; the tell of a spent composition is a difference that shrinks as the families are made more capable, since capable families converge on the modal members; analytical, since the atlas's climb ledgers name the hand that made each breath and fifty-five of eighty-two lists were bred by more than one hand, so the difference set is computable and has not been computed; adds to denominator-manufactures' second net, which uses the two nets' overlap to estimate what both missed, the reading of the non-overlap as a member class; not Blind judge, which rates the passes, since here no one rates and the difference is the yield.
neighbor_test.right: Register rotation diff: the same subject is enumerated under a second register and the two lists are compared, so the composition yields the register's artifacts as a set, items that fail to survive the rotation, and the subject's members as the rest, which register-yields can name for one item and this composition reads for the whole list, as the atlas's register roster, whose thirty-odd registers each assert an unlock and whose rotation over one list would sort its items by which registers keep them, the field guide's species list beside the statute's protected list for the same coast, the same case argued in the legal and the clinical register; the composition's shape is two passes over one subject and a diff; what crosses is the subject's name and the item type, and not the first list; the judgment sits in the reader of the diff, who rules on whether a lost item was the register's or a subject's member the second register cannot reach, which are the two readings of every non-overlap; the degradation is the translation, since a rotator shown the first list writes the first list in the second voice, the diff is empty, and the empty diff reads as all subject and no artifact; the tell is a second list with the same count in the same order; analytical, since the roster exists and the rotation over any list has not been run; adds to register-yields' tell, that an item which cannot be restated flat was the register's, the operational form of that tell, a second register instead of the flat one and the whole list at once.
neighbor_test.separating_case: One hand is asked for the list twice, once in the analytical register and once in the legal register, and a member appears only in the legal list; then two hands are asked once each in the analytical register, and a member appears only in the second hand's list. Both compositions hand a reader a non-overlap with the same two readings, artifact of the pass or member the other pass cannot reach. What separates them is what can be done next: in the first, the same hand is asked a third time in the analytical register, and if the member now appears the diff was noise and if it does not the register made it, so the register composition carries its own control; in the second, no re-ask separates the second hand's prior from the second hand's variance without a swap, which is the edge from Swap and compare. As the two items are written this control is absent from Register rotation diff and the pair collapses into one shape with two knobs; with the repair, the register composition yields a per-item profile over a roster and a control the family diff cannot have, and the pair separates on yield, seat, and next move.

boundary_case: The self-read: the same occupant sits first in the author's seat and then in the critic's, and everything crosses, since the critic remembers being the author. It is tempting because the map's of names passes by seat and rule, not by occupant, so author-then-critic with one occupant is formally two passes, exactly the exchange that Swap and compare performs; and it is the practice's own line, 'a self-read is a self-read'. Ruling: out as a member, in as a limit. It is Residue crossing to the fresh critic with the wall removed entirely, and the map's closing inference already prices it: a composition whose crossing is total cannot certify its own yield from its own seat, so on the fence its yield is zero. Whatever the self-read does find comes from what the occupant forgot between the two sittings, which is fertile-forgettings' loss that creates a capacity, not this map's. Chosen off the author's residue so that this critique is not the twelfth of thirty-eight.

seriation.note: The walk is an honest itinerary and the endpoints are right: nothing crosses in Swap and compare, the author's own rejections cross in Residue crossing to the fresh critic. One placement is by the wrong crossing. Verdict menu is walked at 'a menu in and a word out', but its own text says the record, the ledger, and the menu cross into the seat, which is the thickest inbound crossing on the map and the same one Residue crossing to the fresh critic closes the walk with; the item sits mid-walk because the author sorted it by what crosses out. The fix is not a reorder but a stated key: the walk sorts by the crossing the yield turns on (for Verdict menu, the menu; for Residue crossing, the rejections), and the note should say so, since four items (Verdict menu, Telling the seat its attractor, Cut-only hand with a rewrite slot, Residue crossing to the fresh critic) are one pipeline whose several crossings the walk splits by that key. The hinge at Gap named by one hand is defended and the thin-half/thick-half reading of the degradations is the walk's real teaching.

edges.from_handle: Cut-only hand with a rewrite slot
edges.why: The dependency is real and the silent fix is the right degradation, but the closing clause is false against Check.hs: a cut cascades too, since every edge whose endpoint was the cut item fails 'from is not an item'. What is true is that a cut's cascade cannot be silently fixed, because a deleted item leaves no new endpoint for the label to lie about, so the edges must go; and the checker's floor of four relations means that enough deletions force the cut-only hand to author an edge, an addition the rule forbade arriving through the checker rather than the slot. That is the sharper form of the dependency.
edges.repair_label: If a repair changes an item's text, every edge whose endpoint was that text fails the checker, so the cascade's count is the repair's dependents and not the map's faults; where the repairer re-points the endpoints without re-authoring the labels, the cascade clears and each label now claims of the new text what it argued of the old, so a repair that entered through the rewrite slot exits as a set of edges nobody argued; a cut cascades too, since every edge to the cut item fails, but its cascade cannot be silently fixed, because a cut edge has no new endpoint to lie about and must be deleted, and where the deletions take the map under the checker's floor of four the cut-only hand must author an edge, an addition the rule forbade arriving through the checker rather than the slot.

edges.why: A real conditional: the antecedent (the count is written into the next brief) held for this fleet and can fail. Its 'where' clause is the one that six of six critiques so far support, which is the honest state of the loop's first turn.

The loop is the map's best structural claim, but 'the loop is broken only by a menu whose verdicts cost the seat the same' contradicts the forward edge, which says that where the count is held and never reported the menu's attractor stands: withholding the report also breaks the loop. What symmetric costs alone remove is the attractor. The label should say both, and it now has one data point: this fleet reported the count and six of six seats returned the modal verdict, so the loop's first turn has not yet moved anything.
edges.repair_label: If the corrected fleet's distribution is counted in turn and reported to the next, each fleet's verdicts are set by the previous fleet's count and the menu is only the vocabulary the count is written in; withholding the report breaks the loop and leaves the menu's attractor standing, and the attractor itself is removed only by a menu whose verdicts cost the seat the same, an admit that needs as much evidence as a reject, since then the count carries no instruction the menu did not already carry.

edges.why: The antecedent (occupants drawn from one family) can fail and the consequence is a real incompatibility: the thin end's stability label depends on a measurement the thin end cannot make. A swap that never flips read as the measurement that the difference is empty is an inference the two items alone do not give.

Verified against the climb: the gate only subtracts and the gap-fill prompt carries the list and the type name, so the name is the crossing that moves the proposer. 'The only crossing' is true of the climb as built, not of every such composition (residue could cross to the proposer), and the label is read as a claim about the atlas's design.

A passage with a failing antecedent (a bench of one has no combiner) and a true consequent in Trial.hs: a sign split returns contested regardless of the mean. The contested verdict being the rule's yield and no judge's is a distinction the two items separately do not state.

edges.from_handle: Residue crossing to the fresh critic
edges.to_handle: Judges who cannot see each other
edges.why: The incompatibility holds on the two files as written: the wall stands on the items and falls on the fence. The 'where' clause names the counterfactual fleet, which is the right test. This critique deliberately draws its boundary case off the author's residue, which is the only way a single seat can avoid being another point in the eleven.

modality_problems: Telling the seat its attractor says this fleet's critiques have not run; at my read six of seven had, all admit-with-repairs, with the report in every brief. The prediction is now partly tested and, so far, not borne out. Repaired in the item.

Cut-only hand with a rewrite slot says the repairer is instructed to apply replacement text 'verbatim'; REPAIR.md applies 'verbatim' to the independent_review line only, and separately allows the repairer to preserve an item against the critic as residue. Repaired in the item.
Register rotation diff says the roster has thirty-odd registers; bin/ideonomy registers --ls listed forty-eight on 2026-09-13. Repaired in the item.

Second family's difference says fifty-five of eighty-two ledgers were bred by more than one hand; counting distinct hand prefixes over the eighty-six climb ledgers today gives fifty-nine or sixty. The limits already declare the counts as string matches; the number is method-dependent and should be read as such. Not repaired.

Swap and compare's 'referee pair reversed for the second leg' is not a practice I can place; the crossover a second leg supplies is the ground. Judges who cannot see each other's 'census count and post-enumeration survey kept from each other's rosters' overstates: the survey is collected independently and then matched against the census roster. Both are case-level wobbles that do not touch the mechanism; not repaired.
The edge Cut-only hand to Cascade said a cut leaves no cascade; against Check.hs a cut's edges fail as 'from is not an item'. Repaired in the edge label.

Every other atlas claim was checked against the source and the corpus and held: the swap in balancedTrial, adversary answering last per round, sign split to contested, burden thresholds, Triangulate's refusal below two judges and judge-1 dimensionalizing, Climb's fifteen, three, six, plateau at a quarter and a gate shown no residue, Seriate's smoother-of-two, twenty shuffles, reverse and revelatory flags, the driver's skip, Parley's rotation and maximin, Check's exact-string endpoints, and the counts thirty-eight, two hundred and eight, one hundred and thirty-eight, three, and eleven of thirty-eight.
best_unresolved_seed: The report that does not move the seat. This fleet is the first turn of the map's loop, and six of six seats named the report and returned the modal verdict anyway, so there is a mechanism the map points at and does not contain: an instruction crossing into a seat is absorbed as acknowledgment, the seat proves it read the report by citing it, and the distribution stands. Its carrier is the same one-sentence report, its seat is still the menu, and its tell is a critique whose strongest objection quotes the brief's warning while its verdict is the one warned against. The counterfactual is cheap and specific: rerun one map's critique with the menu's costs made symmetric (an admit must carry as much checked evidence as a reject) and the report withheld, and see whether the verdict moves when the cost moves and not when the report does.
independent_review_line: Fable critic: admitted after repairing three items (the register rotation sharpened against its true neighbour the second-family diff, the seat-attractor item updated with this fleet's six-of-six modal verdicts, the cut-only hand corrected on its brief) and two edge labels (a cut does cascade; withholding the report also breaks the loop), with every atlas count and code claim recomputed and confirmed.
